# libgifcodec source and license notice

This directory preserves all nine original files from upstream libgifcodec commit `d06d2a6d42baf6c0c91cacc28df2542a911d05fe`, used by the native Skia code distributed in SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.Win32 2.88.9. The upstream files are byte-for-byte unmodified. `UPSTREAM.json` records original Git blob IDs, SHA-256 checksums and retrieval URLs; this notice and that metadata are downstream additions dated 2026-10-20.

Upstream source: https://skia.googlesource.com/libgifcodec/+/d06d2a6d42baf6c0c91cacc28df2542a911d05fe/

The original `LICENSE.md` distinguishes MPL-1.1 / GPL-2.0-or-later / LGPL-2.1-or-later portions from the BSD-licensed portions and retains the original authors and copyright notices. For the portions offered under those alternatives, this distribution elects the GNU GPL version 3 under the original GPL-2.0-or-later grant. GPLv3 section 13 permits combination with an AGPLv3 work; it does not change the separate BSD notices or turn these original files into newly authored project code. The original license alternatives remain intact for their recipients.

The full GPLv3 text and original license notice are also provided under `LICENSES/third-party/libgifcodec-d06d2a6d42baf6c0c91cacc28df2542a911d05fe/` in the source release. For rebuilding the containing Skia library, see SkiaSharp commit `9699cdf046a989423a5e5eca68e7fd813486d81c`, its Skia submodule `4bed689c9c9eb77a120c6a9d54af6a572c85d1c2`, and the pinned dependency/build source acquisition information in the distribution's third-party license catalog. These nine codec files do not by themselves constitute the complete containing Skia/SkiaSharp build tree.
